name: PHASE
description: An energetic identity for a development toolkit. An interrupted diagonal, electric turquoise, and sharply cut compositions express progress as an ongoing transition.
heading: syne
rules: Use dark mode as the dominant developer-facing background.
Highlight a single transition with ion instead of adding gradients.

system.concept: Slashed planes, folded technical ribbons, progression diagrams, and a sharp sea-green terminal palette. Progress has a visible direction and a clear structure.
headline: What comes next
starts with a phase.
system.eyebrow: AN OPEN TOOLKIT FOR THE NEXT VERSION
features: A practical structure for getting from an idea to its next version.
Useful primitives and fewer unnecessary choices.
A foundation that supports iteration rather than getting in its way.
system.layoutNote: Dark-mode hero, ion-colored typography, and diagonal folded art. Straight 4px UI corners, mono labels, and a single mint action color. Keep reading panels flat.
